reviews.comment: Great professor, super interesting lectures. He makes the topics so intriguing. Very thoughtful and engaging lectures just show up to class and take good notes and you're good. Don't go on your phone he hates that. You won't want to though, his lectures are great!

I absolutely loved this studio! Initially I wasn't too sure because we had lots of readings and research but you work a lot to end up with amazing projects. He always has a smile on his face and will never fail to make you laugh! Marcelo gives great critiques and will always make sure to help you even outside of class time. Definitely take him!!

Don't expect a cake-walk, this isn't an "easy" class. Be ready to read, learn, and produce work quickly. Marcelo keeps you busy, but pushes you to be your best. I can confidently say this was my favorite studio thus far.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Until the end of the course, I did not like him AT ALL. However he ended up becoming perhaps the best professor I've ever had. He makes things difficult, but it's as if he opens up a part of your brain that you never knew existed. He makes you want to invent new things. His teachings made me start thinking of numerous business ideas. He is great.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Tough grader
